column1: # comment: "Image super-ontology alignments \u2014 schema.org ImageObject, W3C Web Annotation, W3C EXIF Ontology, IIIF, CIDOC-CRM/CRMdig, and Wikidata. GMEOW models the structure natively and bridges by reference (Principle 5)."

column6: comment
ImageRegion projects to iiif:Annotation. Lossy: regionLabel and scene-graph edges dropped.
An ImageRegion with a selector projects to an oa:SpecificResource. Lossy: regionLabel and scene-graph edges are dropped.
Wikidata 'region' (Q10884) is broader than GMEOW ImageRegion; directional lossy projection.
GMEOW MediaObject projects to iiif:Canvas. Lossy: depicts, regions, rights, and capture metadata dropped.
GMEOW MediaObject is broader than schema:ImageObject (it also covers audio and video); directional lossy projection.
RegionSelector projects to oa:Selector. The selectorType determines the concrete selector subclass (FragmentSelector, SvgSelector, etc.).
Wikidata 'spatial relation' (Q215032) is the closest peer to SceneGraphEdge. Directional lossy projection.
captureTime projects to exif:dateTime. Lossy: provenance and confidence dropped.
captureTime projects to schema:dateCreated. Lossy: provenance and confidence dropped.
gmeow:depicts (⊑ gmeow:isAbout, domain MediaObject) projects to schema:about on schema:ImageObject. Lossy: context, audience, period dropped.
Image capture is a production event in CIDOC-CRM terms.
Image processing aligns to CIDOC-CRM modification activity. Directional lossy projection.
Image orientation projects to exif:orientation.
Pixel height projects to exif:height.
Pixel height projects to iiif:height.
Pixel height projects to schema:height (as QuantitativeValue or integer).
Pixel width projects to exif:width.
Pixel width projects to iiif:width.
Pixel width projects to schema:width (as QuantitativeValue or integer).
Pixel rectangle projects to oa:FragmentSelector with xywh media fragment.
SVG path projects to oa:SvgSelector.
